title: Prompt Generasi Visual Edukasi
html:
Berikut kumpulan prompt instruksional pendukung materi:

  1. Struktur Plot Naratif:
Educational infographic showing the basic storytelling structure: Hook -> Setup -> Conflict -> Climax -> Resolution, Indonesian high school students, clean modern educational design, simple visual hierarchy, realistic illustrations, 16:9 landscape.
  1. Komparasi Data vs Cerita:
Educational infographic comparing plain information versus storytelling, left side showing a simple list of school facilities, right side showing a student experiencing those facilities through a sequence of scenes, Indonesian high school environment, clean instructional design, 16:9.
  1. Penerapan Show Don't Tell:
Educational visual comparing "Tell" versus "Show Don't Tell", left side text saying a student is tired, right side visually showing the student walking slowly, putting down a backpack, sitting and taking a breath, Indonesian school environment, realistic photography, 16:9.
  1. Sekuen Visual Storytelling:
Educational infographic showing how five camera shots create a simple visual story: wide shot, medium shot, close up, detail shot, final wide shot, Indonesian high school student performing a school activity, realistic photography, clean instructional layout, 16:9.
  1. Perancangan Storyboard:
Educational infographic showing a storyboard for a short school video, six storyboard panels with sketches of a student arriving at school, entering classroom, studying, facing a task, completing the task, and leaving school, Indonesian high school environment, professional educational storyboard style, 16:9.
  1. Esai Cerita 5 Foto:
Educational visual showing five photographs arranged sequentially to tell a story about a student's school day, arrival, classroom, activity, challenge, and ending, Indonesian high school environment, realistic documentary photography, clean composition, 16:9.
  1. Produksi Mini Dokumenter:
Educational photography showing Indonesian high school students producing a mini documentary at school, one student interviewing a teacher while another records with a smartphone on a tripod, B-roll being captured in the background, authentic classroom environment, documentary photography style, 16:9.
